full.interpretation: Net return from one fixed policy on each sampled deal; computer outcomes are not measured human performance.
full.label: Win-tuned full-information policy

portfolio.interpretation: Full-information per-deal maximum foundation count across frozen restarts. The $52 cost is applied once to the best trajectory; this is not an ordinary paid-play policy or the earnings from separately paid attempts.
portfolio.label: Full-information restart portfolio

visible.label: Visible-information policy

statistics.limitations: Sampling intervals assume IID-uniform deals under the seeded-shuffle interpretation and fixed policies. They are not adjusted for multiple comparisons and do not measure model or human-execution uncertainty.
statistics.mean_interval: Normal approximation using sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(N); null for N=1.
statistics.median_definition: Inverse empirical CDF at q=0.5; lower central value when an even sample straddles a gap.
statistics.quantile_definition: Inverse empirical CDF: smallest observed net return with cumulative probability at least q.
statistics.sd_definition: Sample standard deviation with denominator N-1; null for N=1.
